name: InTaSet
description: Data-driven methods for dynamic model identification, forecasting, and fault detection in water systems research have received significant attention. However, validating these learning-based methods remains a challenge. Simulation-generated datasets, although easily accessible, rely on simplified disturbance descriptions and lack sensor drift. As a result, models trained may fail to transfer reliably to real-world physical systems. Simultaneously, physical laboratory-scale testbeds are expensive to build and rarely available to the broader community.
